summary: The latest case index faithfully preserves all 94 source content blocks, including both tables, four code blocks, every heading/list/paragraph, and the exact PNG figure. Each of the six promoted readers equals its original HTML after only documented href/src adaptations; all 94 copied supporting files and directly mapped non-HTML targets match their original bytes. Local targets and HTML fragments resolve. Static safety and offline Edge checks found no material fidelity, safety, or usability issue. This is a render/portability review only, not validation of mathematical claims, Lean proofs, arithmetic results, or model-review conclusions.

reviewer_route.identity_scope: Configured fresh native reviewer route; no separate provider-side identity attestation.

not_performed: Exhaustive visual inspection of every proof paragraph

index_full_source_body_comparison.method: Independent Markdown subset extraction compared in order with HTMLParser text blocks inside main, excluding generated header/footer; image alt retained.

independent_evidence.index_figure: Base64-decoded embedded PNG equals assets/delta.png byte for byte.
independent_evidence.reader_comparison_method: Parsed original start tags independently; applied only manifest ordinary href/src value mappings at original tag positions; reconstructed text equaled the delivered page exactly. Separately checked unchanged element counts, code blocks, metadata and callout classes, preserved query/fragment, existing local paths, HTML fragments, and exact non-HTML target bytes.

independent_browser.driver: Python Playwright sync API; chromium.launch(channel="msedge", headless=True)
independent_browser.network: HTTP and HTTPS routes aborted; file navigation only

results.k_10_11_12_cells: white-space: nowrap confirmed on latest regenerated index
results.m6_hidden_math: The sole hidden math container is in the historical duplicate body H1, not proof content.

independent_evidence.other_browser_evidence: Read BROWSER_READERS.json (all six pages at desktop and phone sizes) and latest BROWSER_INDEX.json; treated these as supplied evidence, independently supplemented as above.

expected_source_features_checked: Historical reader metadata and dates are unchanged; the current README hash is checked against index metadata. Historical generation metadata is not represented as this publication date.

The historical readers retain inert close buttons and an empty image in a closed lightbox template; there are no scripts or event handlers. These are not missing requested figures or executable content.

Three historical GENERAL_BOUND SVG data images were independently decoded and parsed; no scripts, event handlers, foreignObject, or external references were present. The new index PNG data URI is the documented adapter output.

GENERAL_BOUND retains four duplicate MathJax equation-label IDs from its original source. No href/xlink:href targets any of those duplicate IDs, glyph IDs remain resolvable, and no current rendering or navigation defect was found; no content-changing archive cleanup is requested.
Wide tables/formulas use historical responsive overflow behavior; the current index table first column uses nowrap after the reported CSS fix.
